title: Premium romantic single-page proposal website for Urvi Ji (with animations, gallery, and music)

requirements.text: Create a single-page website with a premium, dreamy romantic visual theme using blush pink, red, white, and gold accents; include soft glow, gentle gradients, and consistent typography (elegant serif for headings + handwritten-style font for personal messages).

quotes:
Theme & Feel:
Soft romantic vibes, love, warmth, dreamy mood, premium look.
Color palette: blush pink, red, white, and gold accents.

acceptanceCriteria: All sections share a cohesive romantic premium style (palette, spacing, typography).
No blue/purple is used as a primary theme color.
Handwritten-style typography is used for the personal message section.

requirements.text: Implement the Hero section with the exact heading text "Hey Urvi Ji ❤️" and sub-text "From the moment you came into my life, everything became more beautiful." Add a visible heart-beat animation on/near the hero heart and subtle entrance animation on load.

quotes:
Hero Section:
Big romantic heading:
“Hey Urvi Ji ❤️”
Sub-text:
“From the moment you came into my life, everything became more beautiful.”
Add a heart-beat animation

acceptanceCriteria: Hero displays the exact requested strings (including emoji).
Heart-beat animation loops smoothly without jank on mobile.
Hero content is centered and responsive across common phone sizes.

requirements.text: Add ambient romantic background effects across the page: (1) floating hearts and (2) gently falling rose petals with soft blur/glow; ensure the effects are performant and can be reduced/disabled based on user preference (e.g., a UI toggle or respecting reduced motion).

quotes: Smooth animations, floating hearts, rose petals gently falling, soft glow effects.

acceptanceCriteria: Hearts and petals animate continuously without blocking scrolling.
Animations degrade gracefully (reduced density/disabled) when reduced motion is enabled or via an on-page toggle.
Effects do not obscure text readability (proper opacity and layering).

requirements.text: Add gentle romantic instrumental background music with a clear music toggle (play/pause + volume or mute). Follow browser autoplay policies by starting muted or only starting playback after explicit user interaction; persist the user’s choice for the session.

quotes: Add a heart-beat animation and a gentle background music (romantic instrumental).

acceptanceCriteria: A visible music control is available and works on mobile and desktop.
Music does not unexpectedly autoplay with sound; playback begins only after user gesture or starts muted.
Toggling music updates immediately and does not reset on scroll within the session.

requirements.text: Create a Love Story section as a timeline or card-style layout containing the three requested beats: “How we met”, “Why she is special”, and “How she calls me ‘good boy’ and how that makes me feel loved”. Provide well-written English copy placeholders for each card/timeline node (editable in code).

quotes:
Love Story Section:
A timeline or card-style section describing:
– How we met
– Why she is special
– How she calls me “good boy” and how that makes me feel loved 🥰

acceptanceCriteria: The Love Story section clearly contains three distinct items matching the requested topics.
Layout is responsive: vertical stacking on mobile; timeline/cards adapt cleanly to larger screens.
Each item has soft animation on scroll-in (non-intrusive).

requirements.text: Implement a Photo Gallery section with a soft animated photo slider/carousel using the two uploaded images (Snapchat-869212999.jpg, Snapchat-261174748.jpg) as initial slides; style it with rounded corners, subtle shadows, and cinematic transitions. Include an “Add photos” UX that lets the user add more images client-side for the current session (no backend persistence required).

quotes:
Photo Gallery Section:
A soft animated photo slider to upload our memories together.
Rounded corners, subtle shadows, cinematic transitions.
The user has uploaded 2 image(s): Snapchat-869212999.jpg, Snapchat-261174748.jpg.

acceptanceCriteria: Carousel renders and transitions smoothly between the two provided images.
Gallery cards/images have rounded corners and subtle shadow consistent with the premium theme.
User can add additional images via file picker and see them appear in the slider for the current session.
No crash if the user adds a large image; slider remains usable (with sensible limits/error messaging).

requirements.text: Add a “Message From Me” section that displays the exact handwritten-style text: “I may not be perfect, but my love for you is pure and forever.” Include subtle paper/ink styling while keeping readability high.

quotes:
Message From Me Section:
A handwritten-style text saying:
“I may not be perfect, but my love for you is pure and forever.”

acceptanceCriteria: The section displays the exact requested string (including punctuation).
Handwritten-style font is applied and remains readable on mobile.
Section has gentle scroll-in animation consistent with the rest of the page.

requirements.text: Create the Proposal section as the main highlight with large glowing text: “Urvi Ji, will you be my Valentine? 💍❤️” and two animated buttons labeled exactly “💖 YES” and “😜 Of course YES”. On click of either button, trigger a celebratory “heart explodes with love” animation and show a sweet pop-up/modal message: “You just made me the happiest person alive 💕”.

quotes:
Proposal Section (Highlight):
Large glowing text:
“Urvi Ji, will you be my Valentine? 💍❤️”
Two animated buttons:
– 💖 YES (heart explodes with love animation)
– 😜 Of course YES
If she clicks YES, show a sweet pop-up message:
“You just made me the happiest person alive 💕”

acceptanceCriteria: Proposal text and both button labels match exactly (including emojis).
Clicking either button opens a modal/pop-up with the exact requested message.
A visible celebratory animation plays on click (heart burst/explosion) without blocking UI interaction.
Modal can be dismissed and is accessible (keyboard focus, close button).

requirements.text: Add a Footer with the exact text “Made with endless love by Mann” (use Mann from the provided name).

quotes:
Footer:
Text:
“Made with endless love by [Your Name]”

acceptanceCriteria: Footer renders at the bottom of the page and shows: “Made with endless love by Mann”.
Footer styling matches the site theme and remains readable on small screens.

requirements.text: Implement smooth scrolling navigation behavior for a single-page flow (e.g., subtle scroll snapping or a small section nav) and ensure the entire page is mobile responsive and fast-loading (optimize assets, avoid heavy libraries). Provide a clear way to share the link (e.g., a “Copy link” button that copies window.location.href).

quotes:
Extras:
– Mobile responsive
– Fast loading
– Shareable link
– Smooth scroll animations

acceptanceCriteria: All sections render correctly on mobile (no horizontal scrolling, no clipped text).
A “Copy link” (or equivalent) control copies the current URL and provides user feedback.
Scroll animations are smooth and do not cause layout shift.
Initial load remains performant (images are reasonably sized; effects are efficient).

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain single-actor architecture (do not introduce multiple canisters/services).
Use English for any user-facing text in the build request and implement the exact English strings provided by the user.
nonGoals: Do not implement user accounts or Internet Identity authentication flows.
Do not add server-side storage for uploaded gallery photos (session-only client-side is sufficient).
Do not integrate third-party services (analytics, external music streaming, social APIs).
Do not build multi-page routing; keep it a single-page experience.

required: Seamless romantic background pattern with subtle hearts and sparkles (romantic-bg-pattern.dim_2048x2048.png)
Rose petal particle sprite sheet, soft semi-transparent petals (rose-petals-sprite.dim_512x512.png)
Heart particle sprite sheet, soft semi-transparent hearts (hearts-sprite.dim_512x512.png)
